notes.title: v0.08 codenamed "Search by tag"
notes.content:
Hello everyone
Here is version v0.08 codenamed "Search by tag" (it's live now!)

[b]Features/Improvements:[/b]
There is now a tagging system, which means:
- All objects have 1 or more tags
- For the moment the tags are just based on names but this will improve later (eg: having more generic tags like "metal", "wood", etc.)
- There is a button to open the tag search window
- A virtual keyboard (this is a first draft, it will improve) allows you to search for a word
- A list of tags appears above (be careful if you type a common letter like "e" you can end up with a tag wall XD)
- Clicking on a tag allows you to add it as a filter in the gallery
- In the gallery, you can remove a tag by clicking on it
- If you have several tags, you can either refine your search with the "and" tag combination option (eg: ammo + pistol) or extend your search with the "or" tag combination option (eg: tree + bush)
- Tags work in both gallery tabs

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
- There was a bug when creating tags, certain tags are called Rock1, Rock2, etc. instead of Rock. This is the case for certain trees too. I need to fix the tag creation process.

[b]What's next for V0.09?[/b]
Several things :
- The tags feature is still very work in progress, there are still improvements to be made. I had to review my entire mesh naming process which was not good. So, it takes time.
- I still had tasks to do regarding the character editor and posing
- Plus a few small features that you asked me for and which shouldn't take too much time to make (inline duplication like in TTVR, attaching windows to the left hand, etc.)

In short, still a lot of things to do XD

[b]Important information![/b]
I'm taking a few days with my family, I'll be back in 10 days.
If necessary, I could respond on discord but I would not have access to a PC (so I hope this version is not too broken XD)
These last 2 weeks have been a little slow, and I think this will continue to be the case for the whole summer until we resume in September.

notes.title: v0.07 codenamed "Character Editor"
notes.content:
Hello everyone
Here is version v0.07 codenamed "Character Editor" (it's live now!)

[b]Features/Improvements:[/b]
- Outlines are back! For those who have been there for a long time, they were already there at the beginning but I had tested other solutions based on overlay (more optimized but I really didn't like the result). As I managed to make the outlines a little more optimized, they are back :)

- Well, I said that I didn't want to have a specialized "editor" for each type of object, but let's say that for characters it's a bit of an exception. So there you have character editor now. This is still only a first draft (I still have lots of things to add) but it will allow you to create your characters much more quickly.

- I reworked and added the parenting features, it's now clearer and allows you to do everything necessary.

- I added a function for posing: "single rotation" which allows you to rotate any object according to the rotation of the controller. Practical for adjusting the rotation of an object in the chain without moving the entire chain. I also renamed "single" to "single look at" which is currently what it does.

- There were also some bug fixes here and there.

[b]Character editor tutorial:[/b]
- The window looks like the gallery
- But if you hover (with the "yellow sphere" cursor) over any object, it will update the preview of the character on the right.
- Once the character suits you, you just have to grab it
- You can also take any object from any category and use it as is for the gallery
- Ah also the head enlarges when you are in a facial category, it's to better see the small details, but don't worry, this only concerns the preview.

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
- As usual, everything is still in progress, there are still bugs, missing features, accessories, characters, etc. Things happen little by little ;)

[b]What's next for V0.08?[/b]
V0.08 will be a bit special: next Monday and Tuesday I will attend developer conferences, so I won't be able to work on the project and the following week I will take 1 week off from Friday so v0.08 will be smaller than usual. I'll keep you posted but expect an update on Thursday July 4 (instead of Friday)

notes.title: v0.06 "Character & Posing WIP"
notes.content:
Hello everyone
Here is version v0.06 codenamed "Character & Posing WIP" (it's live now!)

[b]Features/Improvements:[/b]
Characters :
- It's still in WIP (work in progress) but you have access from the gallery to 5 characters + parts of the faces.
- More characters will arrive later (this is just the beginning)
- There is no customization of accessories yet (hats, glasses, beards, hair, etc.)

- The "duplicate" function is now part of the "select" mode, it's much more logical now.

- There is a new "Swap" mode which allows you to exchange any item for another.
- It works from the gallery, or an object in the scene.
- Just take an object and overlap it to replace it.
- Depending on the mode you are in (Inpsect or not), you can exchange either an entire item or only part of it.
- There are still improvements to be made (especially concerning the parts of the face, it's a bit complicated) but it's already cool to use.

- There is a new "Pose" mode which replaces the old one. This mode has 2 options "chain" and "single":
- In "chain" mode you manipulate a chain of objects starting from the first link you entered (yes there is IK behind...).
- For greater ease, this first link follows the rotation of your controller.
- If your chain only has one link then you only have the rotation.
- In "single" mode, you manipulate a chain of 1 object, it's a sort of "look at" from the object to your controller. (see camera gif)
- "Single" mode can be used on any element of a channel (even in the middle)
- By default the bones are displayed when you manipulate them in "pose" mode
- You can use the "pose" system on any object, even if it was designed for the characters
- There is a "hint" system to help in some cases like character arms or legs.
- The "hint" system is still in WIP, more info on this later
- You can display the "hints" if necessary
- Exception: for the moment it is not possible to manipulate the root of the object in "pose" mode.

- In Inspect mode it is now possible to take objects directly from the gallery, they are automatically added to the hierarchy (this also applies to "swap" mode)

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
- Everything in this version is still Work In Progress, there are new bugs, missing features, accessories, characters, etc.

[b]What's next for V0.07?[/b]
- I will focus on improving everything that is in progress on the characters, the next version will be much more solid and complete.

notes.title: v0.05 codenamed "Hierarchy"
notes.content:
Hello everyone
Here is version v0.05 codenamed "Hierarchy" (it's live now!)

Features/Improvements:
Inspector mode is evolving!
You now have access to the hierarchy (you finally see what I've been seeing all along XD).
This allows
- add an external object to the hierarchy (eg hang a weapon on the handlebars of the motorcycle...)
- remove an object from the hierarchy (eg remove a wheel from the motorcycle to use it elsewhere in the scene...)
- or reorganize the hierarchy (eg if you hang a weapon on the handlebars, it will turn at the same time as the handlebars)

This functionality is also designed for the arrival of characters (eg putting a weapon in their hand, adding accessories, etc.)


I fixed the bug that a user reported to me yesterday, there was a bug (under certain conditions) in scenes where objects had been grouped.
It's corrected but you will have to re-save the existing scene to correct the problem, sorry... -_-

I have also integrated 1/3 of the City pack but I am (still) behind on integrating the assets...

Known Issues:
- As always, there is still a lot of polishing to do, special cases to manage and certainly some bugs to fix, but things will resolve over time, don't worry ;)

What's next for V0.06?
- Ch...
- Chara...
- Charact...
- Yeah characters! You guessed it, you are too good XD

notes.title: v0.04 codenamed "Gizmo & Inspector"
notes.content:
Hello everyone
Here is version v0.04 codenamed "Gizmo & Inspector" (it's live now!)

Features/Improvements:
New Gizmo mode
- You can now choose between "hand" mode and "gizmo" mode
- Gizmo mode allows you to move an object on 1 or 2 of the 3 axes
- But also to orient an object on 1 of the 3 axes
- You can choose between the global (fixed) or local (orients with the object) coordinate system
- This gizmo mode is compatible with collision and grid features (local grid does not work yet)

Inspector mode
- Inspector mode allows you to "enter" an object
- That means you can modify one of the elements of the hierarchy without having to ungroup and regroup everything
- To enter Inspector mode, you press the "A" button on your right controller when an object is highlighted
- In Inspector mode, the object is truly isolated, you cannot modify the others
- A window (empty for the moment) opens when the mode is active, for the moment you have to close it to exit Inspector mode
- But it is still possible to inspect an external object (with the same button)

I have also integrated half of the Knights pack but I am still behind on integrating the assets...

Known Issues:
- There is still a lot of polishing to do, special cases to manage and certainly some bugs to fix. 

What's next:
V0.05
- Finish what was started in v0.04 (collision does not work yet in Inspector mode, etc.)
- Preparing for character (postponed to v0.06)

Please, test this new version and let me know what you think!
Thank you so much !

notes.title: v0.03 codenamed "Posing"
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here is version v0.03 codenamed "Posing" (it's live now!)
No video this time again (next time I promise).

[b]Features/Improvements:[/b]
- There is a new "Pose" mode which allows you to manipulate certain parts of an object easily (see gif).
- The selection has been improved, the old system did not allow you to be inside an object (eg: if you get behind the wheel of a vehicle)
- The collision system has also been improved, in v0.02 if 2 objects touched each other (or were very close) the collision was canceled, there is now a tolerance which allows you to adjust an object stack while keeping collisions.
- The gallery now has a "New assets" tab which will be renewed with each update.
- New items also have a green dot in the gallery.
- The number of objects for each tab is also indicated at the top right.
- Finally the gallery is now explicitly deactivated when it is not possible to use it (eg: in duplicate or pose mode)
- The window edges for moving them are now 2x larger, hoping it's better now ^^
- The grid snap now has a visual grid based on "points" that can be displayed. It's not yet perfect due to object pivots rarely being centered, so more improvements will come in the future.
- Still for the grid snap, the 3 colored axes are displayed above the window to know where the X, Y and Z axes really are. It's not yet perfect either but at least the information now exists.
- The object highlight is a little more subtle and discreet, but hey it will probably change again later ^^
- There are new assets, mainly vehicles, weapons, and other random items (don't ask me why)

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
- The "Pose" system works well as is but it does not yet have an interface for editing axis constraints, so if you group/ungroup parts of objects, there may be strange behavior.
- Do not load a previously created level, it will not load (and there will be an error in the background) because of the "Pose" system which changed along the way.
However, it is possible to save a new level. Sorry!

As usual available on: 
- Steam Playtest
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825570/Diorama_Maker/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825570/Diorama_Maker/[/url]

For V0.04 I plan even more "quality of life" (surprise...) and also a lot more assets, I'm a little late on this part.
And I hope I can start getting the characters for v0.05, who knows...

notes.title: v0.02 codenamed "consolidation"
notes.content:
Hello everyone
Here is version v0.02 codenamed "consolidation".
No video this time (but I will try to make them as often as possible).

Additions:
- There is now a tile at startup (it's better than starting in a vacuum)
- There is now a Settings menu (which will be enriched gradually) with for the moment the option between snap and smooth turn and the possibility of deactivating the object resize snap (which is the behavior by default now)
- Complete rework of Grid snap (still in progress...)
- There was a big rework of the UI, it's not necessarily visible, except for the windows but it was necessary for me to move forward.
- Moreover the windows are now grabbable via the edges (instead of the 2 handles)
- There is now an "exit" button ^^
- I added a few assets but really not many, that wasn't my goal for this update but I'll still let you discover the new ones ;)
- Oh also, there is now a number on certain assets of the gallery which indicates how many objects this asset is made up of.

Bugs fixed:
- Undo/Redo is taken into account for Duplicate
- There is no more misgrab when you want to take an object from the gallery (it tended to scroll by itself)
- Environment information (time of day and moon phase) is now also saved with the scene
- Lighting no longer affects the gallery and controllers
- And finally, what literally took me a week to correct: the collisions that remained stuck when duplicating inside another object.
Long story short, physics engines are made to manage collisions but manage quite poorly when 2 physics objects are perfectly superimposed, so after testing several solutions, the best (least worst?) that I found is to leave a little time for the engine (0.3s) to realize the situation. And it's working pretty well at the moment.

There are still lots of things to do but that will be for the next version in 2 weeks! ;)
